method.pilot: Cole, single player, fresh browser saves for each entry
method.assistance: playerHit is replaced only inside test browsers; the bot remains visible and cannot die. Starting equipment and finite missile stock remain native. No enemy HP, phase, wave, timer or kill is forced.
method.controls: Movement/fire, native rolls and somersaults, finite manual missiles, native pursuit selection. Fusion is released before overload.
method.timing: Accelerated native 60-update-per-second loop with frequent lazy-asset yields; not a real-time performance or audio-mix benchmark.
method.scope: Levels 1–9, Normal/Hard/Furious, both Stage 6 paths. Stage 7 naturally transitions into Stage 8 and the connected runs continued through the final boss as well. God mode does not certify human survival balance or every pilot/weapon combination.

finding.before: Radio movement worked, but the unconfirmed pursuit prompt froze player position and effect time.
finding.cause: The older fr27 route handler returned before flight updates while wing.choice remained set.
finding.change: Poll the existing pursuit input once, temporarily clear its pause flag while waiting, restore it after the native update. Hold new arrivals and preserve stage/wave clocks as before.
